summary: NeoVolta Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a firm commitment underwritten offering of 12,195,122 shares of common stock at $2.05 per share, raising approximately $25 million gross ($23.5 million net before expenses). The offering price reflects a 25.7% discount to the last sale price of $2.76 on May 26, 2026. Underwriters have a 30-day over-allotment option for up to an additional 1,829,268 shares. The offering is expected to close May 29, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration; it does not constitute a special situation such as a restructuring, capital return, or going-private transaction.
